items.headline: Gukesh-Sindarov: sabse yuva chess final
items.detail: Vishwa Chess Championship ka pehla game aaj Geneva me khela jayega; dono khiladi 20 saal ke hain, itihaas ka sabse yuva final hai.
items.exam_angle: Vishwa Chess Championship, sabse yuva final — UPSC sports
items.image_credit: Frans Peeters / CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Iowa visfot ko court ki hari jhandi
items.detail: Court ne paryavaran samoohon ki yachika kharij kar di; sena Budhvaar ko Iowa plant me 68 barrel lead azide ka niyantrit visfot karegi.

items.headline: Mahila World Cup 2031 America me
items.detail: FIFA ne 2031 Mahila World Cup America, Mexico, Costa Rica aur Jamaica ko diya; 2035 ka UK me hoga aur pehli baar 48 team khelegi.
items.exam_angle: Mahila World Cup 48 team, pehli baar chaar mezban — UPSC sports

items.headline: Zanzibar me aag, 6 hotel jale
items.detail: Nungwi Beach par Makofi Hotel se shuru hui aag 6 hotel tak phaili; lagbhag 180 paryatak surakshit nikale gaye, kuchh hotel karmchari ghayal hue, jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Manchester concert me gas, 12,000 nikale
items.detail: Don Toliver ke show ke dauran Co-op Live arena me 'agyat padarth' chhoda gaya; 12,000 se zyada log nikale gaye, 50 se zyada logon ka ilaaj hua aur ek ko aspatal le jaya gaya, jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Kyiv kshetra me hamle, 15 mare
items.detail: Dymer me paanch-manzila imarat par hamle me 11, Vyshneve supermarket me 3 aur Bila Tserkva me 1 vyakti mara; Zelenskyy ne America se Patriot missile ki maang dohrai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, nagrik nuksan, Patriot — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia ke parmanu upgrah par NATO satark
items.detail: German media ki report ke mutabik Russia 'Sputnik-S' parmanu hathiyaar wala upgrah kuchh hafton me launch kar sakta hai; NATO pramukh Rutte ne antariksh me raksha ka bharosa diya, Kremlin ne aarop kharij kiye.
items.exam_angle: Antariksh hathiyaar, Outer Space Treaty 1967 — UPSC IR/S&T

items.headline: Democrats ko 1992 ke baad sabse badi jeet
items.detail: North Carolina ki seat jeetne ke baad Democrats ke paas House me kam se kam 258 seatein hain — 1992 ke baad sabse zyada; Senate me bhi 56 seatein, 3 January ko shapath.
items.exam_angle: America madhyaavdhi chunav, Congress, vibhajit sarkar — UPSC IR

items.headline: EU ka Russia par 22va pratibandh package
items.detail: European Commission ne 60 Russian banks ko SWIFT se hatane, crypto aur shadow fleet par sakht pratibandh ka prastav rakha; sabhi 27 deshon ki sahamati zaroori.
items.exam_angle: UPSC: EU pratibandh, SWIFT, shadow fleet — Bharat-Russia vyapar par asar

items.headline: ICJ: Myanmar ne Rohingya par narsanhar kiya
items.detail: 9-6 faisle me court ne 2017 ke sainya abhiyan ko narsanhar mana; pehli baar kisi desh ko doshi thahraya gaya aur vapsi aur muavze ka aadesh diya.
items.exam_angle: UPSC: ICJ, Genocide Convention, Gambia v. Myanmar — pehla state-responsibility faisla
items.image_credit: International Court of Justice; originally uploaded by Yeu Ninje at en.wikipedia — Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Ukraine ne Libya me Russian yuddhapot duboya
items.detail: Ravivar ko samudri drone se Libiya bandargah me Russian korvet duboya gaya; Zelenskyy ne pushti ki, yuddh ka daira Europe se bahar badha.
items.exam_angle: UPSC: Ukraine yuddh ka daira — Libya, samudri drone yuddh

items.headline: COP31 bina samjhaute ke khatm
items.detail: Antalya me jeevashm indhan ka ullekh na karne wale draft ko EU aur 130 deshon ne kharij kar diya; vaarta bina antim ghoshna ke samapt hui.
items.exam_angle: UPSC: COP31, jeevashm indhan phase-out, jalvayu vitt — Bharat ke liye sabak

items.headline: Korea me Russi vimaan par alert, phir wapas
items.detail: Ulleung dweep par subah 7:52 baje evacuation alert jaari hua aur 3 minute me wapas liya gaya; sena ne saaf kiya Russi vimaan KADIZ me aaye the, hawai kshetra ka ullanghan nahi hua aur ladaku vimaan bheje gaye.
items.exam_angle: KADIZ aur hawai kshetra ka antar — UPSC IR

items.headline: NATO bhejega Poland ko AWACS vimaan
items.detail: Shukravar ko teen Russi missile Poland me girne ke baad NATO ne early-warning AWACS vimaan bhejne ka faisla kiya; Poland ke up-raksha mantri ne Brussels me elan kiya aur SACEUR ne tainati ko manzoori di.
items.exam_angle: NATO AWACS, Poland-Russia tanav — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Timothy A. Gonsalves, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

items.headline: America ne Iran ki shadow banking par pratibandh
items.detail: America ke Vitt Mantralaya ne Somvar ko Iran ke shadow banking network se jude do dozen se zyada exchange house, front company aur vyaktiyon par pratibandh lagaye; FinCEN ke mutabik January 2025 se August 2026 tak lagbhag $14.7 arab ki gatividhi is network se judi mili.
items.exam_angle: Pratibandh, shadow banking — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Trump: Naye saal ke baad Iran par hamle
items.detail: Rashtrapati Trump ne Fox News ko kaha saal ke ant tak samjhota na hua to naye saal ke baad Iran par dobara bade hamle karne ke paksh me hain; unhone Iran par baatchit me taang adaane ka aarop lagaya aur naakabandi todne wale jahaazon ko doobane ki chetavani bhi di.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav, naakabandi, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Israeli sena me aatmahatya 16 saal me sabse zyada
items.detail: Haaretz ki report ke mutabik 2026 me ab tak 23 sakriya Israeli sainik aur adhikari aatmahatya kar chuke hain — 16 saal me sabse zyada; yuddh ke baad seva chhodne wale 17 aur sainikon ne bhi is saal aatmahatya ki, jabki yuddh se pehle ke dashak me ausat 12 thi.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Gaza yuddh ka manaviya asar — UPSC IR

items.headline: AI bikwali se Kospi 3.3% gira, chip share toote
items.detail: AI share bikwali se Dakshin Korea ka Kospi Somvaar ko 3.3% girkar band hua — din me 5.8% tak gira tha; Samsung 3.1% aur SK Hynix 2.5% toote, aur America me Nvidia 14% girne ke baad Asia bhar ke bazaar laal rahe.
items.exam_angle: AI bubble chinta, global share bazaar — UPSC economy

items.headline: Nvidia ne Jensen Huang ko CEO wapas banaya
items.detail: Nvidia ke board ne Somvaar ko Jensen Huang ko turant prabhaav se CEO aur adhyaksh ke roop me wapas bahaal kiya — 12 November ko unke istife ke 11 din baad; board ne kaha America sarkar se input ke baad unki wapasi se rashtriya suraksha ko koi khatra nahi, aur Trump ne faisle ko sahi bataya, jabki Nvidia ke share 31% se zyada chadhe.
items.exam_angle: AI chip, Nvidia, America-China tech tanav — UPSC economy/S&T

items.headline: Grameen Bank ki lagbhag 100 shakhaon par hamla
items.detail: Bangladesh me November me Grameen Bank ki lagbhag 100 shakhaon par petrol bomb se hamle hue — bank ke memo me 10 se 23 November ke beech 97 ghatnayein darj hain; poorv antarim pramukh Muhammad Yunus ne Somvaar ko hamle rokne aur doshiyon ko saza dene ki maang ki, aur kaha unka apna ghar bhi nishana bana.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh raajneeti, Grameen Bank, microfinance — UPSC IR

items.headline: CrowdStrike khareedega Zscaler, $43.9 arab
items.detail: Cybersecurity company CrowdStrike ne Somvaar ko Zscaler ko lagbhag $43.9 arab ke all-stock saude me khareedne ki ghoshna ki; Zscaler ke har share par 1.135 CrowdStrike share milenge, aur sauda CrowdStrike ke vitt varsh 2028 ki doosri chhamaahi me band hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha vilay, AI khatre — UPSC economy

items.headline: Kim: suraksha chahiye, varchasva nahi
items.detail: Uttar Korea ke neta Kim Jong Un ne Ravivaar ko naye rajdooton ke saamne kaha Pyongyang apni suraksha ke liye shakti badhayega, lekin kshetriya varchasva ya vistaar nahi chahta; unhone hathiyaar badhotri ko aatmaraksha ka adhikaar bataya.
items.exam_angle: Uttar Korea parmanu karyakram, purvi Asia suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kryvyi Rih hamle me bachcha, paramedic mare
items.detail: Zelenskyy ke grih nagar Kryvyi Rih me Shukravaar raat Russia ke ballistic missile aur drone hamle me 7 saal ka ladka aur 20 saal ki paramedic mare, lagbhag 60 log ghayal hue; bachav dal par bhi dobara hamla hua.

items.headline: Gaza me vaahan par hamla, 3 mare
items.detail: Gaza City me Shanivaar ko khaadya vaahan par Israeli hamle me 3 log mare; Gaza ne unhe sahayata-karmi bataya, jabki IDF ne kaha ve Islamic Jihad ke sadasya the; World Central Kitchen ne kaha vaahan uska nahi tha.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhviram, WCK, Israel-Hamas — UPSC IR
